scenarios.target_failure: Leader pod killed via SIGKILL under active 25k req/s load
scenarios.details: Hot standby replica promoted to leader; replayed 42 WAL packets from Kafka; zero duplicate matches.

scenarios.target_failure: Primary database pod crash during high-frequency settlements
scenarios.details: Patroni cluster detected master failure, promoted synchronous replica; WAL sequence verified intact.

scenarios.target_failure: Broker 1 partition dropped from zookeeper/controller quorum
scenarios.details: Producers failed over to broker-2 and broker-3 in-sync replicas (min.insync.replicas=2); 0 events dropped.

scenarios.target_failure: 500ms network latency + 15% packet drop injected between Gateway and upstream
scenarios.details: Envoy outlier detection tripped on 3 consecutive 5xx timeouts; ejected degraded upstream and shed load.

scenarios.target_failure: Validator 3 completely isolated from peer network
scenarios.details: Consensus maintained by 3 remaining validators (2F+1=3 quorum). 2-second block intervals continued uninterrupted.
Chain paused cleanly without generating divergent forks. Upon partition heal, validators synced missing blocks in 8.4s.
